_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); premium revenue, medical care ratio, fee revenue, operating cost ratio and operating margin signals with UnitedHealth Group's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'UnitedHealth Group is a diversified health care company dedicated to helping people live healthier lives and helping make the health system work better for everyone.' 'If we fail to estimate, price for and manage our medical costs in an effective manner, the profitability of our risk-based products and services could decline and could materially and adversely affect our results of operations, financial position and cash flows.' 'Premium revenues from risk-based benefits products comprise nearly 80% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names health benefits, and no 10-K names offshore delivery; the FY17 10-K names cloud only among OptumInsight's own solutions for care providers ('compliance, cloud-enabled collaboration and consumer engagement'), not as a substitute for UnitedHealth Group's business), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

'Premium revenues from risk-based benefits products comprise nearly 80% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names health benefits, and no 10-K names offshore delivery; the FY17 10-K names cloud only among OptumInsight's own solutions for care providers ('compliance, cloud-enabled collaboration and consumer engagement'), not as a substitute for UnitedHealth Group's business), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 4.06x; +130% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.23; conservative 2yr -31%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +14.0%/yr (FY18 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.4%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +33.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNH (retrospective, 2018-05-18) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 4.06x (61.8% downside to Bear $93.38 / +15.2% upside to Bull $281.92) | Adj composite 2.06 vs market 3.29: gap -1.23 [OVERVALUED] | +130% above the EPP floor $106.42 (9x FY18E $11.82) | Conservative 2-yr case: -30.8% total (-15.4%/yr) | At 20.7x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $323.54 sits above the BULL case; revenue +13.3% YoY in Q1 2018, forward revenues +10.9-11.9% (FY18 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
